cases.title: Pacific & Atlantic Oceans
cases.description: The two largest bodies of water on Earth.
steps: 1. Pacific Ocean: The largest ocean in the world. It separates Asia/Australia from the Americas.
2. Atlantic Ocean: The second largest. It separates Africa/Europe from the Americas.
The Atlantic Ocean lies to the West of Africa.

cases.title: Indian & Arctic Oceans
cases.description: The warm ocean of trade and the cold ocean of the North.
steps: 3. Indian Ocean: Lies to the East of Africa. It is named after India.
4. Arctic Ocean: Located around the North Pole. It is the smallest and coldest ocean.
Most of the Arctic Ocean is covered by ice throughout the year.

cases.title: Antarctic / Southern Ocean
cases.description: The ocean that surrounds the frozen continent.
steps: 5. Southern Ocean: Also called the Antarctic Ocean.
It completely surrounds the continent of Antarctica.
It is known for strong winds and very cold temperatures.
